# Formlabs SLA printing resins: # FORMLABS_CLEAR_V4: three-term Cauchy fit (n = c1 + c2/lambda^2 + c3/lambda^4
# lambda in um) to the manufacturer's measured refractive indices for cured
# 1.505 @ 656 nm ("Optical properties of selected Formlabs SLA resins"
# formlabs.com/support). The fit reproduces every measured point within
# 3.3e-4 (the table itself is rounded to 1e-3) and gives n_d = 1.5084
# V_d = 55.5. Valid over the measured 486-656 nm range; treat values
# outside it as extrapolation. Independent measurements (Optica OME 11
# 3392 (2021)) report 1.505-1.533 over 405-670 nm and an Abbe number of
# dispersion table published — usable for a first monochromatic layout
